reason: Critical blockers remain (empty main(), missing/misaligned required metrics, incomplete parameter normalization/usage, mandate logic gaps). With one remaining iteration, targeted fixes can make the simulation executable and compliant with the spec. The codebase is structurally solid, so a focused final iteration should yield significant improvement.

specific_areas: Implement main() to instantiate Simulation, run(), evaluate(), and print required spec metrics

Add and align required evaluation metrics: policy_compliance_rate (visit-weighted at required-policy locations), mask_availability (avg_inventory, stockout_rate), price_level (avg of daily avg_price), adoption_inequality_by_income (top 20% vs bottom 20% income), and alias time_to_50pct_adoption

Normalize and implement spec parameters: enforcement_probability, campaign_frequency_days, restock_period_days, supply_delay_days, location_mask_requirement_default, purchase_threshold_price_sensitivity
Fix mandate activation logic to support mandate_active_initial and start-only or end-only windows
Map spec weights to internal decision logic: social_influence_weight, authority_trust_weight, risk_signal_level, decision_noise
Implement retailer restock queue with restock_period_days and supply_delay_days; adjust price dynamics accordingly
Behavioral purchasing gate using purchase_threshold_price_sensitivity and affordability
Compute adoption_inequality_by_income using income quantiles (q20 vs q80)
Track daily_contacts per agent; track required-policy visits and compliant visits
Optimize free mask distribution using id_to_agent map
Ensure evaluate() returns correctly named metrics and minimal time series as required
Add a small smoke test path (e.g., N=200, days=30) in main() or test harness; seed determinism

task_understanding.adjustments: Reconcile the implementation strictly with the task spec. Maintain a mapping doc between spec parameter/metric names and internal names; ensure all required metrics and behaviors are present and correctly named.

data_analysis.adjustments: Define income quantiles (20th and 80th percentiles) for inequality; verify visit-weighted compliance calculations; validate inventory and stockout definitions for mask_availability.

model_planning.adjustments: Plan minimal invasive changes to add mandate flexibility, enforcement_probability gating, periodic campaigns, and restock queue. Sequence: parameter normalization -> policy/media/market updates -> behavior mapping -> aggregator metrics -> main().

code_generation.adjustments: Implement the prioritized fixes with clear function-level comments. Use O(1) lookups for free distribution. Keep interfaces stable and avoid breaking existing modules; add aliases for metric names where needed.

code_verification.adjustments: Add a smoke test to run a short simulation and assert presence of required metrics. Static checks: run syntax/type checks where possible. Validate mandate toggle edge cases and restock queue delivery timing.

simulation_execution.adjustments: Implement main() to run a default plan, print key metrics, and optionally save results. Use a fixed seed for reproducibility and ensure no exceptions during run.

result_evaluation.adjustments: Ensure evaluate() returns spec metrics with exact names. Add alias time_to_50pct_adoption. Cross-check that policy_compliance_rate is visit-weighted at required-policy locations and that mask_availability aggregates avg_inventory and stockout_rate.

feedback_generation.adjustments: Provide a concise change log highlighting fixes to main(), metrics alignment, policy/media/market updates, and performance optimization. Include a brief summary of smoke test outputs to evidence compliance.
